option.setup.1.help: Each player receives a ready-to-play starting deck: sheet music, Partner musician, Contacts and hand. Recommended for a first game.
option.setup.2.help: Each player receives 10 cards, may once put some under the draw pile and draw as many, then keeps 7. They then choose a starting musician, their Contacts and their sheet music.
option.setup.3.help: Each player receives 8 cards, keeps one and passes the rest to the next player, until they have kept 7. They then choose a starting musician, their Contacts and their sheet music.
option.decks.1.help: Each player receives a random starting deck.
option.decks.2.help: In turn, counterclockwise starting with the last player, each player chooses one of the remaining starting decks. The first player chooses last.
option.level.help: In solo, you face the Stradivarius bot. Each level adds rules to the previous one.
option.level.1.help: Stradivarius crafts, restores and raises its activity level. It plays first.
option.level.2.help: In addition: during Conservation, it discards pairs of cards from its Contacts to value its violins in Heritage.
option.level.3.help: In addition: during Conservation, it trains apprentices from its Contacts for 2 studies.
option.level.4.help: In addition: you play first, its tokens go to Studies, and its Prestige 4 musicians value its violins.
